name: A1_mom_raw
hypothesis: 12-1 month momentum ranks the next 90-day returns (fixed composite, nothing fitted).

name: A2_mom_sector_relative
hypothesis: Sector-relative momentum carries more stock-specific information than raw momentum because it removes common sector moves (compare A1; only the feature changes).

name: A3_ridge_price
hypothesis: A fitted linear combination of price features (reversal, momentum, volatility, drawdown) ranks returns.
warnings: ["4 lots frozen at last mark at the end"]

name: A4_ridge_price_fin
hypothesis: Point-in-time fundamentals, size and liquidity add information beyond prices (compare A3; only features change).

name: A5_ridge_all_sector_relative
hypothesis: Adding sector-relative versions of momentum, volatility, profitability and value improves ranking (compare A4; only features change).

name: A6_hgb_all_sector_relative
hypothesis: Gradient-boosted trees capture nonlinearities/interactions the linear model misses (compare A5; only the model changes).

name: A7_theory_composite
hypothesis: A theory-signed equal-weight composite (quality, low accruals, value, low volatility, momentum, short-term reversal) generalizes at least as well as fitted models (compare A5).

name: B1_top50
hypothesis: Holding 50 instead of 30 names per cohort diversifies idiosyncratic risk without diluting the signal much (vs A7 base; only n changes).

name: B2_inverse_vol
hypothesis: Inverse-volatility sizing lowers portfolio risk for the same names (vs A7 base; only sizing changes).

name: B3_monthly
hypothesis: Monthly cohorts (3 overlapping) instead of weekly (13) trade less with similar exposure (vs A7 base; only schedule changes).
